During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] wielded a '''blue single-bladed lightsaber'''.

==History==
When she turned sixteen<ref name="MedStar II" /> in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] constructed her own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], choosing a [[Color/Legends|blue]] crystal as its signature hue. As part of her [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]<ref name="MedStar II" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Offee accompanied her [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to reassemble [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Offee used it to defend herself from the [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|droids]] planting explosives in an [[Ambush on Ilum|attempt to destroy]] the temple.<ref name="CW 14">{{CW|14}}</ref> After being buried in, the pair had then been saved by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="CW 16">{{CW|16}}</ref>

[[File:BarrissVsAnakin-TWJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Anakin Skywalker used the lightsaber against Barriss Offee.]]
Offee used her lightsaber throughout the rest of the war until her fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], when she [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombed]] the temple, killing workers, clones, and framed her friend, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] for the crime. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came to her quarters, he took the lightsaber as he "casually" engaged Offee in inquisitive conversation before activating it and lashing at her. She was forced to defend herself using [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|the lightsabers]] she'd stolen from [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], giving herself away. The two engaged in an intense duel, Skywalker using Offee's own lightsaber along with [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|his own weapon]] against her. During the fight, Offee leaped from a ledge to attack Skywalker, the force of her attack knocking her former weapon out of Anakin's hand. It was last seen lying on the ground as Offee was disarmed and arrested.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While the [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'' establishes that Barriss Offee built her lightsaber when she was sixteen,<ref name="MedStar II" /> the [[Chapter 14 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|fourteenth]] episode of the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' microseries depicts Offee building her lightsaber during the war.<ref name="CW 14" /> [[Leland Chee]]'s "[[Ask Lobot]]" article in ''[[Star Wars Insider 121]]'' mentions the discrepancy between the episode and other pre-Clone Wars sources of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that featured the lightsaber.<ref name="Ask Lobot">{{InsiderCite|121|Ask Lobot}}</ref> This article assumes that the mention of Barriss Offee reassembling and taking the lightsaber apart as part of her training in ''Jedi Healer'' is depicted in the ''Chapter 14'' of the microseries.
